answer: Under the reef, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Admission requires two or more co-signatures from seasoned identities, and a proven fake penalises every signer. Through the shale, a clone army needs an army of co-signers first, and each signature is a reputational bet no honest agent places on a stranger twice. The oasis does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
